column3: A stored attachment records the files index's path, type, size and sha256 at message.send, and a turn reads its bytes by sha256 (files.readBlob)
column4: The client's size and type were trusted and every render stat'd and read each path again (two index rows per file per render, plus on replay); with the sha stamped once at send the render reads zero index rows, and a replay after a crash renders the same bytes even if the path was overwritten. Rows written before this lose their attachments on retry (they had no sha), at most 7 days of a single owner's items
column5: plugins/intake/attachments.test.ts 'stores the upload in R2, records it on the message and sends a vision model the image' asserts the recorded sha256 and size from storage, not the client's 999
